name: ecommerce-product-search-embeddings
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.033 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-07-20. Caveat: the gain over its base is +2.3 nDCG@10, which the card itself calls 'real but modest'. Judged pools, so absolute recall@100 is a lower bound. The model also degrades slightly more under typo noise than base (-3.5 vs -3.2 points), reported on the card rather than hidden.

benchmarks.name: ESCI test nDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Card table on the held-out ESCI test split (8,956 queries, judged pools): this 0.7483 vs bge-small-en-v1.5 0.7250, non-overlapping 95% bootstrap CIs.
